_readme: Model assumptions. Everything here is editable in the GitHub web editor. Numbers marked 'assumption' are starting defaults from published studies or rules of thumb, not facts; the model replaces what it can with fitted values once there is enough ground truth.

prior_sales_per_review_by_release_year._note: assumption: starting review multiples by release year, from published review-to-sales studies (VG Insights, GameDiscoverCo 'NB number', Gamalytic). The fitted model adjusts these using your ground truth.

model._ridge_note: Higher = trust the published priors more and your ground truth less. With few ground-truth rows the model stays close to the priors automatically.
model._sd_note: assumption: used for the uncertainty band until the backtest has at least 15 rows; 0.35 in log terms is roughly +/-45% at 80% confidence

revenue._refund_note: assumption: share of gross refunded; set to 0 if you believe review-based unit counts are already net of refunds
revenue._discount_note: assumption: average effective discount on units sold in each age bucket. Months where the crawler has recorded actual Steam prices use the observed discount instead.

regional_pricing._note: Review language is used as a proxy for where buyers are. Each language maps to a Steam store country whose price is converted to USD (ex-VAT) and compared to the US price. VAT rates and the fixed factors are assumptions.
